name: guardrails
description: Security primitives for an AI app: reversible PII masking (emails, phones, names, custom patterns) to redact before text leaves your trust boundary; per-principal spend/rate caps over an injected atomic store; and untrusted-content fencing + an advisory injection detector for prompt safety. Zero-dependency pure core.

adapters.name: memory-store
adapters.desc: An in-memory CapStore for dev/tests (single-process). Shows the contract a real atomic store (Upstash/Postgres) must meet; see the file header for an Upstash sketch.
